name: The Shades of Red
source:
The Shade of red is a romance/horror yandere visual novel were you meet Isaac Redfield.

A recently trending painter, who agreed to give you painting lessons.

[From [url=https://kuroyurivn.itch.io/the-shades-of-red]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《The Shades of Red》是一部融合恋爱、恐怖与病娇元素的视觉小说。在这里，你会遇见艾萨克·雷德菲尔德。

他是一位最近声名鹊起的画家，答应教你画画。

[摘自[url=https://kuroyurivn.itch.io/the-shades-of-red]Itch.io[/url]]
